requirements.req_text: Do the following: (a) In a three- or four-paragraph treatment, tell the story you plan to produce, making sure that the treatment conveys a visual picture. (b) Prepare a storyboard for your motion picture. Note: This can be done with rough sketches and stick figures. (c) Demonstrate the following motion picture shooting techniques: (1) Using a tripod (2) Panning a camera (3) Framing a shot (4) Selecting an angle (5) Selecting proper lighting (6) Handheld shooting (d) Using motion picture shooting techniques, plan ONE of the following programs. Start with a treatment and complete the requirement by presenting this program to a pack or your troop, patrol, or class. (1) Film a court of honor and show it to an audience. (2) Create a short feature of your own design, using the techniques you learned. (3) Shoot a vignette that could be used to train a new Scout in a Scouting skill.

requirements.req_text: Do ONE of the following: (a) Explore careers related to this merit badge. Research one career to learn about the training and education needed, costs, job prospects, salary, job duties, and career advancement. Your research methods may include—with your parent or guardian's permission—an internet or library search, an interview with a professional in the field, or a visit to a location where people in this career work. Discuss with your counselor both your findings and what about this profession might make it an interesting career. (b) Explore how you could use knowledge and skills from this merit badge to pursue a hobby or healthy lifestyle. Research any training needed, expenses, and organizations that promote or support it. Discuss with your counselor what short-term and long-term goals you might have if you pursued this.

Core Standard 2 (Req 4): Research one career to learn about the training and education needed, costs, job prospects, salary, job duties, and career advancement.
step_by_step_procedure: Prepare & Inspect (Req 4): Review the official Moviemaking requirement standard and verify all required tools, reference tables, and safety gear.
Analyze Core Principles: Identify the primary concepts, definitions, and cause-and-effect relationships governing Moviemaking Careers, Training & Hobby Pathways.
Execute & Document: Perform the explain task methodically with your patrol buddy and log specific observations in your Moviemaking Workbook.
Verify With Counselor: Present your completed work, demonstrate proficiency, and answer Socratic check-for-understanding questions for Blue Card sign-off.

options: Agree with the claim so the patrol can finish the requirement faster
Correct the misconception: Scouts must research three Moviemaking careers and discuss the specific education, training, licensing, and daily duties for one chosen career with their counselor.
Skip Requirement 4 until after the troop court of honor
Sign off the Blue Card without completing the practical verification
quiz_item.correct_answer: Option B - Correct the misconception: Scouts must research three Moviemaking careers and discuss the specific education, training, licensing, and daily duties for one chosen career with their counselor.
